comment: HS 846789 (hand tools with self-contained non-electric motor, other) is wrong for this company: BPCL is an oil refining and marketing PSU, and no chapter-84 hand-tool line appears anywhere in its documented portfolio. Corrected actual codes are chapter 27 (271019 petroleum oils, 271111/271121 gas/LNG), 340319 lubricants and chapter 29 petrochemicals. Industry claim 'Строительство и DIY' (construction & DIY) is a clear industry misclassification - the correct industry is oil & gas / downstream refining & marketing. Legal name in the input ('BHARAT PETROLEUM COMPANY LIMITED') differs from the actual registered name 'Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited' (BSE 500547, NSE BPCL) - a naming error in the record, not an HS issue. Per rule 3 the company is retained and the code corrected; verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Note on evidence: bharatpetroleum.in returned HTTP 403 to automated access, so the product list is corroborated only by the Wikipedia article citing BPCL's Annual Report 2025-26 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bharat_Petroleum) - the official site itself could not be read. No customs line was checked in this task (out of scope), therefore the specific export/import HS lines for BPCL remain 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level; the product-to-HS mapping above is based on the documented product portfolio only.
